name: Tsinghua Tongfang Co., Ltd.
summary: Tsinghua Tongfang Co., Ltd. engages in public safety, digital intelligence, and smart energy businesses in China and internationally. It operates through the Public Safety; Digital Industry; Smart Energy; Headquarters Investment and Technology Parks; and Other Business segments. The company offers security inspection equipment and comprehensive security inspection solutions; as well as knowledge services, digital transformation services, artificial intelligence, and data elements. It also provides energy production, transmission, distribution and consumption of heat pump products and energy management technologies.
